name: Bresser 6-in-1 weather sensor
description: Bresser 6-in-1 outdoor weather sensor on 868.3 MHz, FSK with a plain clocked bitstream (PCM): there is no mark/space pattern to measure, so framing is anchored to the 16-bit sync word 0x2dd4 that follows the longer alternating preamble. A 16-bit LFSR digest over the id, sensor_type, channel and the undeclared payload bytes protects the frame. FIELDS CANNOT BE DECLARED YET for temperature, humidity, wind and rain: those bytes pack two BCD digits across byte boundaries and the wind bytes are conditionally byte-inverted depending on which of two mutually exclusive frame layouts (wind/UV or rain) is present, neither of which this schema's flat bit-offset fields can express.
